observation.command: cd /workspace && echo "=== look for error/success in login response ==="; grep -iE "fehler|error|fail|invalid|angemeldet|welcome|success|logout|dashboard|passwort|incorrect" /tmp/loginresp.html | head; echo "=== try following redirect to / with cookie ==="; JAR=/tmp/cj.txt; curl -s -b $JAR -c $JAR -H "Host: tfm-fachplanung.ddev.site" http://127.0.0.1:32789/ -o /tmp/after.html -w "HTTP %{http_code} size=%{size_download} redirect=%{redirect_url}\n"; echo "--- title after ---"; grep -iE "<title" /tmp/after.html; echo "--- any dashboard nav? ---"; grep -iE "Fachplanung|Gesamtplan|Antragsbuch|logout|Logout" /tmp/after.html | head
